note: Independent rejudge after 4594143b56. Draft Section 4: "The Software Version Capability MUST only be used for displaying the version of a BGP speaker's router daemon to make troubleshooting easier." Producers at HEAD conform: parseCapability returns code 75 as an Unknown holding a copy of the raw value; Negotiate's remote loop only sets peerCodes[75] for it (no type case matches Unknown), remoteOrder takes Multiprotocol entries alone; the reactor's RefusedCapabilities and RequiredCapabilities are filled only by applyCapMode (config_capabilities.go), which is never called with code 75, so validateCapabilityModes cannot act on it; the softver plugin's own refuse mode only suppresses advertisement and its decode path is display. Positive: exact Unknown code and bytes after parse, and PeerAdvertised(75) after Negotiate, which is what a display reads; a revert record (Negotiate body panics) goes red. Negative isolates code 75 (two OPENs identical but for one Unknown placed between the two Multiprotocol entries) and asserts Families with order, Identity, Encoding, Session and the named session fields, then the previously unchecked peerCodes: with.peerCodes must equal a copy of without.peerCodes plus {75: true} exactly, then the whole Negotiated (unexported fields included, via reflect equality) with peerCodes cleared. That closes the 10e10198ce finding: a Negotiate that marks any extra code (for example 70, which selects RFC 7313 handling via PeerAdvertised, or a refused code read by CheckRefusedCodes) when it sees 75 now goes red; the recorded mutant (also mark code 70 on 75) was observed red at that assertion. The family-order mutant record was replaced (one record per requirement, polarity and unit), but the in-order Families assertion with 75 between the Multiprotocol entries remains in the body, so that break is still caught. The positive and negative are distinct assertions, not one test with two tags. Residual, not a finding: proof is at the capability boundary; reactor-level non-use rests on the reads above (every session decision reads Negotiated or config lists that never carry 75).
